The biological scheme presupposes the model-based controller is outcome-informative when its prediction error is low; the FAIL matches the signature of that dependency being absent. Translation note: SD-081's 'habit' is a depth-2 read of the same E3 scorer, not a cached model-free value (Dezfouli & Balleine 2013 already on file) -- a known abstraction choice, not load-bearing here.

Reach shows the plumbing, not appropriate recruitment: the planned argmin the weight recruits is itself uninformative here. Re-test the benefit leg only after a cheap P5 pilot shows planned-only vs habit-only return separation >= 0.2 in at least one cell. failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1083_2026-09-25.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Make E3's planned (full-horizon) pathway outcome-informative: an action-conditional E2 world prediction reachable by E3's full-horizon score, without collapsing SD-081's planned/habit depth contrast
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: DEDUPE FIRST: if governance registers a row from GFLAG-0485 (open evidence_discrepancy on SD-056/SD-063; it does not itself name a row) before applying this autopsy, treat this as action amend on that row. Adjacent existing rows, neither covering this consumer: e2-world-forward-sleep-trainer (implemented_pending_validation; an E2 world-head training pathway -- overlaps leg (i)'s target, not its mechanism) and SD-PP-B5-z-world-per-step-displacement-range (implemented_validated_negative; the head barely reads the action -- the same defect leg (i) targets); no row covers score depth / horizon aggregation. Leg (i): E2 world head trained so it predicts ACTION-CONDITIONAL consequences (the 2d848ca2d3 addenda: action-diverse / balanced data; monostrategy 88-99%-one-class data reproduces the action-blind k=0 signature), with a ree_core-owned waking objective (R1; today only experiment-lib warmup_train trains it). Leg (ii) is NOT 'match the scored horizon' alone: V3-EXQ-1083's habit_only arm IS the R2 depth-2 selection (e3_selector.py:1928-1931, _score_depth_limit = max(2, habit_depth)) and it did not separate from full-horizon selection on return (0.035), so depth-matching alone is measured inert on this row's validation statistic. Any depth change must keep the planned scored depth strictly greater than dualsystem_habit_depth (or add a separate planned-depth knob), or SD-081's non-degeneracy precondition P1 fails by construction. ADDENDUM 3's working pair was R5 + R2 with COV not necessary, in a regime with no benefit channel and an untrained harm head -- neither holds on the 811a lineage. Validation for THIS consumer: planned_only vs habit_only episode-return separation >= 0.2 in >= 1 cell on the 811a lineage (the V3-EXQ-1083 P5 statistic); note 0.2 is about the largest return shift any manipulation produced here (~0.15-0.20), so it doubles as a competence probe.

targets.requeue_guidance: No same-question re-queue until the planned pathway is outcome-informative. Any re-queue of the benefit leg must first run a cheap P5 pilot (planned_only vs habit_only only, 2-3 seeds) and proceed only if separation >= 0.2 in a cell. A different bed where the pathways separate by construction is also admissible as a new EXQ. The 0.2 P5 bar is about the size of the largest return shift any manipulation produced in this regime (~0.15-0.20), so the pilot is effectively a competence probe.
non_outcome_observations: The E2-perturbed cell lengthened survival in 5/8 seeds in every arm (e.g. seed 6 +90..+104 steps) and shortened it in 2-3 seeds; the effect is shared across arms within a seed (common weights and RNG), so it is a seed x cell effect, not an allocation effect. Suggestive of GFLAG-0485 (noise in E2 does not hurt and sometimes helps a policy that already chooses on uninformative rollout content) but NOT adjudicated as an allocation effect -- 3 seeds go the other way. The identical +0.154 shift for planned_only and habit_only is used in prerequisites as consistent-with evidence (see facts.e2_noise_invariance).
E3 ticks are ~28% of steps (499 E3 ticks over ~1774 steps, seed 0 adaptive); the arbitration acts only on those ticks.
